proposal.fov_resize: RGB resize to160 using INTER_AREA; existing max(channel)>10/largest external filled contour on this grid only; uncalibrated estimate
proposal.native_point_transform: Grid pixel center(xg,yg) maps to native((xg+0.5)*W/160-0.5,(yg+0.5)*H/160-0.5); transform support points to native BEFORE weighted PCA/residual/width tests. Use inverse center mapping for grid sampling.
proposal.fov_distance_conversion: Grid distance transform times min(H,W)/160 gives declared approximate native distance for orientation heuristic; this is not calibrated or an exact anisotropic metric.
proposal.component_rank: Sum current P_fiber mass per component using vectorized bincount; descending mass, then component label. No GT/history/FOV-entry bonus in current proposal ranking. Components are proposal seeds, never instance identities or mask filters.
proposal.axis: Weighted PCA, weights current P_fiber; component projected2/98percentiles. Use deterministic evenly spaced row-major support subsampling if>2048. For measurement collect current threshold-supported points from ALL components within candidate corridor and bounded axial extension; do not fill gaps.
proposal.orientation: Current estimated-FOV distance at proximal/distal support ends; nearer end is provisional entry. Difference<0.02D => orientation ambiguous: export unoriented shaft evidence, no strong entry/front pose. History may resolve a weak candidate orientation, never promote it to independent strong evidence.

observation.native_scale: s=min(H,W)/400; all at400 pixel constants scale bys; keep explicit grid/native coordinate transform
observation.border_policy: Only count samples whose required RGB/probability offsets lie inside native frame; padded/interpolated-outside zeros must never create supported edges. Record valid sample counts.
observation.edge_definition: Bilinear native RGB samples I(p+delta*n),I(p-delta*n); normalized L2 color difference /sqrt(3). This differs from old full-frame Sobel strength;0.04 is an engineering hypothesis, not copied calibration. Choose maximum supported contrast per fixed search strip, ties nearest seed boundary then coordinate.
observation.station_without_current_evidence: No invented edge pair; skip station, preserve missing support in diagnostics. Current-seeded stations need at least4 current support-grid points in axial band halfwidth=visible_extent/8. History candidate uses bounded predicted strips but still requires current RGB support and neural evidence.
observation.interior_sampling_policy: Evaluate all8station x3interior positions on fitted lines where in-bounds, not just stations whose edges passed. Require at least5station triplets in-bounds; log actual denominators and missing triplets, do not condition away low-probability interior points.
observation.front_policy: For qualified shaft, bounded axial RGB/probability transition search around current seed distal extent; for history candidate around predicted front if not expired. Score=RGB contrast+0.25*max(P_inside-P_outside,0); transition supported if contrast>=0.04 OR probability drop>=0.15. Require center and at least1 flank, supported axial spread<=shaft distal width. Center transition yields visible_front_candidate. No fitted semicircle/ellipse or inferred physical tip; occlusion boundary can still masquerade as a visible front, record unverified identity.
observation.missing_front: Export observed shaft only; never shorten fiber because front was not observed. No fixed blue threshold; white/low-saturation front is allowed if current contrast/probability evidence supports it.

quality.score: qN=mean interior P_fiber; qE=supported edge pairs/8; qR=exp(-RMS_residual/max(2*s,0.12*median_width)); score=.4qN+.4qE+.2qR. Strong also requires positive valid geometry, width family, qN>=0.5, argmax fraction>=0.75,>=5 pairs and RMS<=limit. Weak requires same edge/geometry rules and qN>=0.10, no winner-fraction rule. Scores are not identity probabilities.
quality.deduplication: After evaluating the at-most2 current axes, merge duplicate geometric hypotheses when ALL current support-grid ID sets have IoU>=0.8 and axis difference modulo pi<=5deg; keep higher current-evidence score, then component-label tie. No backfill beyond original2axes. This merges proposal metadata only, never fills/relabels mask components; log duplicate provenance. History is a separate conditioned candidate, not an independent vote.
quality.ambiguity: Compare top2 qualified current hypotheses by CURRENT evidence only. If score gap<0.10, mark identity/pose ambiguous, do not force-select one because one fiber is expected. History may accept a compatible weak observation, never relabel it independent strong. Partially observed front/entry fields retain their own validity flags.
quality.blue_prior: Not used in this finite control; no HSV/hue/blue hard gate or new fitted appearance model. RGB color difference is edge evidence, not blue identity.

state.representation: Six joint image parameters ex,ey,axis_theta,L,w0,w1, with per-group availability; no cap-ratio field or physical cap radius. Derived front=e+L*u only if L available. w1 is line-model width at front, not anatomical head diameter. Shaft observation may remain available when entry/front orientation or endpoint group is unavailable.
state.strong_current: Evaluate independent current evidence BEFORE prediction validity/gates. First strong unambiguous observed fields initialize; in-gate strong fields use alpha-beta. Out-of-gate strong fields are accepted this frame, reset their velocities; no fixed3-frame confirmation. Missing fields are not invented or labeled observed. Invalid predictions cannot suppress new strong current observations.
state.weak_current: With existing compatible prior only, update observed groups by alpha-beta; apply gates only to jointly available fields, log skipped gates. Without usable prior export weak observation but do not initialize an asserted complete pose. Out-of-gate weak observations rejected, no persistence-only promotion to strong.
state.partial: Track shaft group(ex,ey,theta,w0) and endpoint group(L,w1) availability/age separately. An unoriented line is separately exported raw evidence, not a valid entry/axis state-group initialization/override; history-resolved orientation is weak only. Front without valid orientation cannot initialize endpoint group. If front absent, do not set L to component end or extrapolate w1 and call it observed. Predict endpoint group at most3frames with explicit predicted flag, then clear it while an oriented current shaft can remain available. Derived endpoint using current shaft and predicted L is explicitly a prediction.
state.missing_or_invalid: Current raw segmentation always retained. Predict only valid prior groups with increasing ages; expire after3 missing/rejected frames. Invalid group prediction clears that group, never discards simultaneously valid strong current evidence. Source/shape/time reset clears all groups. No future/retroactive updates, no cross-image/video state. No calibrated uncertainty probability.
